chunks: Ahmad ibn Mihran, from Muhammad ibn Ali and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad — all together — from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whatever Ali (peace be upon him) came with, I take hold of it, and whatever he forbade from, I refrain from it. It flows for him from merit the like of what flowed for Muhammad (may God bless him and his family), and for Muhammad (may God bless him and his family) the merit is over all of what God, Mighty and Majestic, created. The one who disputes him in any of his rulings is like the one who disputes God and His Messenger, and the one who rejects him in a small or large matter stands at the limit of shirk with God.

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was the Gate of God which cannot be approached except through him, and His Path such that whoever travels by other than it perishes. And likewise do the Imams of Guidance proceed one after another — God made them the pillars of the earth lest it shake with its inhabitants, and His far-reaching proof over those above the earth and those beneath the soil.

And Amir al-Mu'minin (the blessings of God be upon him) used to say often: 'I am God's Distributor between Paradise and the Fire; I am the Greatest Differentiator; I am the owner of the Staff and the Branding Iron. All the angels, the Spirit, and the Messengers have acknowledged to me the like of what they acknowledged to Muhammad (may God bless him and his family), and I have been loaded with the like of his burden — and it is the burden of the Lord.

And indeed the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) will be called and clothed, and I will be called and clothed; he will be questioned and I will be questioned, then I shall speak at the level of his speech. And I have been given qualities that no one before me has preceded me to: I was taught the deaths, the tribulations, the lineages, and the decisive speech. Nothing that came before me has escaped me, and nothing that is hidden from me has escaped me. I give glad tidings by the permission of God, and I fulfill on His behalf — all of that is from God who has empowered me with His knowledge.'

Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Jumhur al-'Ammi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said: Al-Mufaddal narrated to us saying, 'I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say,' — then he mentioned the first hadith.

key_terms.الشِّرْكُ: Shirk — associating partners with God, the gravest sin in Islam

key_terms.الْمُتَعَقِّبُ: One who disputes or seeks to overturn (a ruling)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about the authority of Imam Ali and the Imams as pillars of the earth?
ai.summary: This narration, transmitted from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) through the close companion al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, presents a series of profound declarations about the supreme authority of Imam Ali (AS) alongside the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW). The Imam first states that following Ali (AS) is equivalent in merit to following the Prophet, and that objecting to Ali's rulings constitutes a form of shirk. The narration then quotes Ali (AS) in the first person claiming a cosmic role as God's distributor between Paradise and Hell, and cataloguing exclusive divine knowledge granted to him. Historically, this hadith belongs to the Shia theological tradition affirming the doctrine of imamate — that the Imams hold a divinely-appointed authority paralleling that of the Prophet, making it foundational creedal content for the community addressed by al-Kulayni.

Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whatever Aliasws came with, take with it, and whatever heasws forbade from, refrain from it. It flows for himasws from the merits like what flowed for Muhammadazwj, and for Muhammadsaww is the merit upon the entirety of the creatures of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. The pursuer upon himasws regarding something from hisasws decisions is like the pursuer upon Allahazwj and upon Hisazwj Rasoolsaww, and the rejecter upon himasws regarding a small (matter) or a big (matter), would be within the limits of Shirk (Association) with Allahazwj.

It was so that Amir Al-Momineenasws was a Door of Allahazwj which one cannot approach except through himasws, and Hisazwj Way which, if one was to travel with other than it, he would perish; and similar to that, it flows for the Imamsasws of the Guidance, the one after the other. Allahazwj Made themasws as the stabilisers of the earth, lest it shakes with its inhabitants, and Hisazwj eloquent Divine Authorities upon the ones above the earth and the ones beneath the soil.

And Amir Al-Momineenasws was frequently saying, ‘Iasws am the ‘Allahazwj’s Distributor’ between the Paradise and the Fire, and Iasws am the Great Differentiator, and Iasws am the owner of the Staff and the Branding Iron. And they have acknowledged to measws, the entirety of the Angels and the Spirit, and the Rasoolsas, with similar to what they acknowledged to Muhammadsaww with, and Iasws am loaded upon like hissaww load, and it is the load of the Lordazwj.

And that (on the Day of Judgment), Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> would be Called, so he<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> would be clothed, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> would be Called, so I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> would be clothed; and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> would be Interrogated and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> would be Interrogated (about our<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> followers). So I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> shall speak upon a limit of his<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> speaking. And I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> have been Given qualities to that no one has preceded me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> to these by anyone with before me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>. I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> know the deaths, and the tribulations, and the decisive sermons. Thus, nothing was missed out from me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, that which preceded me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, and nothing escapes from me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, that which is hidden from me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>. I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> give Glad Tidings by the Permission of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> will fulfill from it, all of that, from Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Who Enabled me<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> with regards to it by His<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Knowledge’.

Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour the blind, from Muhammad Bin Sinan who said, ‘Al Mufazzal narrated to us saying, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying’, ... then he mentioned the former Hadeeth’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ahmad ibn Mahran from Muhammad ibn Ali and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad altogether from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Mufaddal ibn ‘Umar from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Whatever Imam Ali (a.s.) has brought I follow them entirely and whatever he has forbidden I desist from them altogether. Whatever virtue that were found in the Holy Prophet (s.a.) were found in Imam Ali (a.s.) also. The Holy Prophet was more virtuous than all of the creatures of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High. Those turning away from any item of his (Imam Ali) guidance would be like one turning away from the guidance of Allah and His Prophet. Rejecting him in small or a great one matters would like considering things like Allah (shirk).

Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) was the gate to Allah through which only, people could go closer to Him. Imam Ali (a.s.) was the path that if one would ignore it he would have been destroyed. This is also true of all the Imams of guidance one after the other. Allah has made them as the cornerstones of the earth so that people on it would not be destroyed. They possess the doubtless Divine authority over the inhabitants of earth and those below the earth.

Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) would very often say, “I am the supervisor for Allah to see who should go to Paradise and who should go to Hell. I am the greatest criterion, the possessor of the staff and the (marking) seal Miysam All the angels and the spirit have acknowledged the existence in me of all the matters that they had acknowledge in Prophet Muhammad (s.a.). I am held responsible for all such matters that Prophet Muhammad (s.a.) was held responsible. Such responsibilities are the duties to Allah, the Lord.

The Holy Prophet will be called upon and his call will be accepted. I will be called up on and my call will be accepted. The Holy Prophet will be made to speak and I will be made to speak and I will speak just the way he would speak. I have been given certain distinctions which are given to no one before me. I was taught all about the deaths, the sufferings, the genealogy of people and clear speeCh I have not missed any of the knowledge that have passed me by and nothing of the future is unseen or unknown to me. I give good news by the permission of Allah and do my duty towards Allah. All of these is from Allah Who has made it possible for me through His knowledge.”

Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ari has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Jumhur al-‘Ammi from Muhammad ibn Sinan who has said that al-Mufaddal narrated to us from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.). He then narrated the above Hadith.
